description_short: VIASM-IAMP Summer School on Probability and Mathematical Physics at VIASM, Hanoi, 23-28 July 2027, a satellite event of ICMP 2027 in Da Nang. Four mini-courses and ten contributed talks by young participants. In-person registration via online form by 1 July 2027.
